_note: Synthetic fixture, Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-024: unit-conversion defect). A contract laboratory transmitted concentration in mg/L while the receiving interface's spec comparison assumed mg/mL -- a 1000x silent magnitude error. Represented as a lab_results conflict, the same category B-003 already exercises for OOS/OOT disagreement, since a unit mismatch IS a conflict between two readings of 'the same' measurement.

findings.gap_description: Assay result LR-5502 was transmitted by the contract laboratory as 4.8 mg/L; the receiving interface's spec comparison assumed mg/mL, producing an apparent 1000x discrepancy against the acceptance range. The two unit-labelled readings have not been reconciled to a single value.
Release packet cannot be marked complete while the unit-conversion discrepancy on LR-5502 is unresolved.
